body:
## Why

Setup says "You can change any of this later" (`frontend/src/routes/NewTripPage.tsx:147`), but no UI control edits a trip and the API has no `PATCH`/`PUT` on `/api/trips/{trip_id}` (`DELETE GET /api/trips/{trip_id}` only). Mistyped dates require deleting the trip and losing prices, notes, and policy state.

`POST /api/trips` returns 201 when `origin`, `start_date`, `end_date`, or `primary_regions` are outside `trip_frame`, silently discarding them and creating a trip with no destination or dates.

## Scope

`trip_planner/app/routes/trips.py`, `trip_planner/app/schemas/trips.py`, trip services, and a setup-edit entry on the workspace or trip detail page.

## Non-Goals

No bulk editing or trip duplication.

Editing must not silently keep stale policy verdicts: a changed trip invalidates its verdict.

## Tasks

- [ ] Add `extra="forbid"` to the trip-create schema in `trip_planner/app/schemas/trips.py` so unknown top-level fields return 422 naming the field.
- [ ] Add `PATCH /api/trips/{trip_id}` in `trip_planner/app/routes/trips.py` to update title, purpose, origin, dates, destinations, and party; clear the saved policy verdict when a determinant changes.
- [ ] Add an "Edit trip setup" workspace-header entry that reuses the `NewTripPage` form.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `tests/app/test_trips_api.py` verifies POST with top-level `start_date` returns 422, PATCH changes the destination and workspace lead route, and the previous verdict is removed.
- [ ] Removing `extra="forbid"` causes the POST 422 assertion to fail; restoring it makes the test pass.

## Implementation Notes

Reproduction:

```bash
curl -s -X POST [LOCAL_HOST]/api/trips -H 'content-type: application/json' -b cookies \
  -d '{"title":"x","summary":"x","mode":"business","start_date":"2026-10-05","primary_regions":["Chicago"]}' | jq '.trip.trip_frame'
# -> 201, primary_regions [], start_date null
```

## Why

- Setup says "You can change any of this later" (`frontend/src/routes/NewTripPage.tsx:147`), but no control in the UI edits a trip, and the API has no `PATCH`/`PUT` on `/api/trips/{trip_id}` (surface inventory, 2026-09-22: `DELETE GET /api/trips/{trip_id}` only). A mistyped date means deleting the trip and losing its prices, notes and policy state.
- `POST /api/trips` answers **201** for a payload whose `origin`, `start_date`, `end_date`, `primary_regions` are sent outside `trip_frame`, and silently discards them. The trip is created with no destination and no dates. This misled the audit's own probe on 2026-09-22 and an earlier price gate in this repo.

## Scope
`trip_planner/app/routes/trips.py`, `trip_planner/app/schemas/trips.py`, trip services, a setup-edit entry on the workspace or trip detail page.

## Non-Goals
- No bulk editing or trip duplication.
- Editing must not silently keep stale policy verdicts: a changed trip invalidates its verdict.

## Tasks
- [ ] Reject unknown top-level fields on trip create with 422 (`extra="forbid"`), naming the field.
- [ ] Add `PATCH /api/trips/{trip_id}` for title, purpose, origin, dates, destinations, party; clear the saved policy verdict when a determinant changes.
- [ ] Add "Edit trip setup" in the workspace header, reusing the NewTripPage form.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] **Test gate** `tests/app/test_trips_api.py`: POST with top-level `start_date` returns 422; PATCH changes the destination and the workspace lead route changes with it; the previous verdict is gone. **Deliberate break:** remove `extra="forbid"` — the 422 assertion fails; revert passes.

  -d '{"title":"x","summary":"x","mode":"business","start_date":"2026-10-05","primary_regions":["Chicago"]}' | jq '.trip.trip_frame'
# -> 201, primary_regions [], start_date null
